Conditionally on jump count, Poisson event-time vectors have densities; Fourier/Riemann-Lebesgue equidistribution gives stable independent uniform phases, but the fine phase is the SAME uniform doubled modulo 1, not an independent uniform. The pointwise dyadic identity (1-u)-(1-{2u})/2=1_{u<1/2}/2 gives iid conditional Bernoulli marks and Var(D|J)=(a^2/16) sum H_j^2 exp(2a(1-T_j)). Finite jump count and a.s. finite marks justify the pathwise finite sum without moment assumptions. Independent deterministic Euler grid expansion and phase identity were checked; finite test is not proof of stable convergence.
